title.tr: Kayıp çanta: tarif etmek, «hangisi?» diye sormak, sıfatlar ve büyük sayılar
title.en: A lost bag: describing things, asking «which one?», adjectives and big numbers

blocks.tr:
Bu bölümde insanları ve eşyaları tarif etmeyi (*ψηλός, μικρή, καινούργιο*) ve «hangisi?» diye sormayı öğreneceksin. Ayrıca «dün oradaydım», «yarın burada olacağım» demeyi ve 1.000 ile 3.000.000 arası sayıları öğreneceksin.

Anahtar nokta: Türkçede sıfat hiç değişmez (*küçük çanta*, *küçük ev*). Yunancada sıfat, tarif ettiği ismin **cinsiyetine** uyar: **μικρή** τσάντα, **μικρό** σπίτι.
blocks.en:
In this chapter you learn to describe people and things (*ψηλός, μικρή, καινούργιο*) and to ask «which one?». You also learn «I was», «I will be» and the numbers from 1,000 to 3,000,000.

The key point: the adjective matches the **gender** of its noun: **μικρή** τσάντα, **μικρό** σπίτι.

blocks.tr: Bir şey kaybettin ve onu tarif etmen gerekiyor: büyük mü, ne renk, yeni mi? Dinlerken sıfatların sonlarına dikkat et.
blocks.en: You have lost something and must describe it: size, colour, new or old? Listen for the adjective endings.

blocks.tr: Dinle, sonra oku. Yeni sözcükler: [[εδώ]] (burada), [[Τι έχει μέσα;]] (İçinde ne var?), [[Εντάξει]] (tamam). Kurallar aşağıda.
blocks.en: Listen, then read. New words: [[εδώ]] (here), [[Τι έχει μέσα;]] (What is in it?), [[Εντάξει]] (OK). The rules follow below.

setting.tr: Ayşe metroda çantasını kaybetti. Karakola gidiyor; memur çantayı tarif etmesini istiyor.
setting.en: Ayşe has lost her bag on the metro. She goes to the police station, and the officer asks her to describe it.

lines.en: Good morning. How can I help?

lines.el: Καλημέρα. Χθες ήμουν στο μετρό και τώρα δεν έχω την τσάντα μου.
lines.tr: İyi günler. Dün metrodaydım ve şimdi çantam yok.
lines.en: Good morning. Yesterday I was on the metro, and now I don't have my bag.

lines.el: Πώς είναι η τσάντα σας; Μεγάλη ή μικρή;
lines.tr: Çantanız nasıl? Büyük mü, küçük mü?
lines.en: What is your bag like? Big or small?
Old, but it is very nice.

lines.el: Ένα βιβλίο κι ένα κινητό. Το κινητό είναι καινούργιο.
lines.tr: Bir kitap ve bir cep telefonu. Telefon yeni.
lines.en: A book and a mobile phone. The phone is new.
Yes, one thousand two hundred euros.
OK. I will be here tomorrow.

lines.el: Ευχαριστώ πολύ. Θα είμαι κι εγώ εδώ.
lines.tr: Çok teşekkürler. Ben de burada olacağım.
lines.en: Thank you very much. I will be here too.

blocks.tr: Sonra Ayşe bir arkadaşıyla bir fotoğrafa bakıyor (*fotoğraf*: [[η φωτογραφία]]). Kim kim?
blocks.en: Afterwards Ayşe looks at a photo with a friend ([[η φωτογραφία]], the photo). Who is who?

setting.tr: Eleni ve Ayşe bir partiden kalma bir fotoğrafa bakıyor.
setting.en: Eleni and Ayşe look at a photo from a party.

lines.el: Ποιος είναι ο κύριος που είναι με τη Μαρία στη φωτογραφία;
lines.tr: Fotoğrafta Maria'yla birlikte olan bey kim?
lines.en: Who is the man who is with Maria in the photo?

lines.el: Είναι ο Νίκος, ο φίλος της.
Όχι, ο κοντός. Ο ψηλός είναι ο Κώστας.
lines.tr: Hayır, kısa olan. Uzun olan Kostas.
lines.en: No, the short one. The tall one is Kostas.

lines.el: Και ποια είναι η κοπέλα που είναι στο μπαρ;
lines.tr: Peki barda olan genç kadın kim?
lines.en: And who is the young woman who is at the bar?

lines.el: Είναι η Σοφία. Είναι νέα και πολύ όμορφη.
lines.en: That is Sofia. She is young and very pretty.

title.tr: Sıfat isme uyar: καλός, καλή, καλό
title.en: The adjective matches the noun: καλός, καλή, καλό

blocks.tr:
Sıfat (*επίθετο*) eril isimle **-ος**, dişil isimle **-η**, nötr isimle **-ο** alır. Bu birinci gruptur. Vurgu yerinden oynamaz: *ψηλός, ψηλή, ψηλό*.
Biçim, *είναι*'den sonra da artikel ile isim arasında da aynıdır.
blocks.en:
The adjective (*επίθετο*) takes **-ος** with a masculine noun, **-η** with a feminine one and **-ο** with a neuter one. This is group 1. The stress does not move: *ψηλός, ψηλή, ψηλό*.
The form is the same after *είναι* and between the article and the noun.

note.tr: Renkler de sıfattır: μαύρος, κόκκινος… Sözlükte çoğu kez nötr biçimle görürsün (μαύρο, κόκκινο).
note.en: Colours are adjectives too: μαύρος, κόκκινος… In word lists you often see them in the neuter form (μαύρο, κόκκινο).

note.tr: Artikel ile isim arasında: το **κόκκινο** φόρεμα.
note.en: Between the article and the noun: το **κόκκινο** φόρεμα.

blocks.tr:
İkinci grupta dişil **-α** ile biter. *-ος*'un önünde bir **ünlü** (ι, ε, υ) varsa dişil **-α** olur: παλι**ός** → παλι**ά**, νέ**ος** → νέ**α**, ωραί**ος** → ωραί**α**. Önünde ünsüz varsa dişil genellikle **-η** olur (*ψηλή, μικρή*).
İstisna: birkaç sıfat ünsüzden sonra da **-ια** alır. İkisini bil: *γλυκός → γλυκιά* (7. dersteki kahveden) ve *φρέσκος → φρέσκια*. Her sıfatı üç biçimiyle öğren.
blocks.en:
In the second group the feminine ends in **-α**. After a **vowel** (ι, ε, υ) before *-ος*, the feminine is **-α**: παλι**ός** → παλι**ά**, νέ**ος** → νέ**α**, ωραί**ος** → ωραί**α**. After a consonant it is usually **-η** (*ψηλή, μικρή*).
The exception: a few adjectives take **-ια** after a consonant. Know these two: *γλυκός → γλυκιά* (the coffee word from Lesson 7) and *φρέσκος → φρέσκια*. Learn each adjective with all three forms.

note.tr: Son iki satır istisna: ünsüzden sonra -ια. *Νέος* hem «genç» hem «yeni» demektir; eşya için «yeni» çoğu zaman *καινούργιος*'tur.
note.en: The last two rows are the exceptions: -ια after a consonant. *Νέος* means both «young» and «new»; for things, «new» is usually *καινούργιος*.

items.el: Ο Νίκος είναι νέος και πλούσιος.
Η Σοφία είναι νέα και πλούσια.

blocks.tr:
*Ποιος* hem «kim?» hem «hangi?» demektir ve isme uyar: **ποιος, ποια, ποιο** (okunuşu *pyos, pya, pyo*). Tek başına da durur, isimden önce de.
Burada özneyi soruyor; başka biçimleri sonra gelecek.
blocks.en:
*Ποιος* means both «who?» and «which?», and it matches the noun: **ποιος, ποια, ποιο** (read *pyos, pya, pyo*). It stands alone or before a noun.
Here it asks about the subject; other forms come later.

items.el: — Ποιος είναι ο Κώστας; — Ο ψηλός.
items.en: — Which one is Kostas? — The tall one.

items.el: — Ποια είναι η Σοφία; — Η νέα.
items.en: — Which one is Sofia? — The young one.

items.el: — Ποιο φόρεμα είναι ακριβό; — Το κόκκινο.
items.en: — Which dress is expensive? — The red one.

note.tr: İsimle birlikte: ποιο **φόρεμα**. Cevapta artikel + sıfat yeter.
note.en: With a noun: ποιο **φόρεμα**. In the answer, article + adjective is enough.

title.tr: Dün ve yarın: ήμουν, θα είμαι
title.en: Yesterday and tomorrow: ήμουν, θα είμαι

blocks.tr:
*Είμαι*'nin geçmişi **ήμουν** («idim»), geleceği **θα είμαι** («olacağım»): *θα* + bildiğin biçim. Şimdilik yalnızca **ben** ve **sen** (tekil). Konuşmada *ήμουνα, ήσουνα* da duyarsın.
Sıfat yine uyar: bir kadın *Ήμουν πολύ νέα* der.
blocks.en:
The past of *είμαι* is **ήμουν** («I was»), the future **θα είμαι** («I will be»): *θα* + the form you know. For now only **I** and **you** (singular). In speech you also hear *ήμουνα, ήσουνα*.
The adjective still matches: a woman says *Ήμουν πολύ νέα*.

items.en: Yesterday I was on the metro.
Were you at the bar yesterday?
Tomorrow I will be at the office.

blocks.tr:
Türkçede *Atina'da oturan arkadaşım* dersin: yan cümle isimden **önce** gelir. Yunancada isimden **sonra** küçük bir kelime gelir: **που**. Hiç değişmez; cinsiyet ya da sayı almaz. İki cümleyi birleştirir.
Dikkat: *που* (aksansız) «ki / olan», *πού* (aksanlı) «nerede» demektir.
blocks.en:
Turkish puts the clause **before** the noun (*Atina'da oturan arkadaşım*). Greek puts **που** («who, that») **after** it. It never changes. It joins two sentences.
Careful: *που* (no accent) is «who/that»; *πού* (accent) is «where».

rows: Ο φίλος μου μένει εδώ. Ο φίλος μου είναι μηχανικός.
Ο φίλος μου που μένει εδώ είναι μηχανικός.

items.el: Ο φίλος που μένει εδώ είναι ψηλός.
items.en: The friend who lives here is tall.

items.el: Η κοπέλα που δουλεύει στο μετρό είναι από την Κρήτη.
items.en: The young woman who works on the metro is from Crete.

blocks.tr:
**1.000** tek başına *χίλια*'dır. **2.000**'den itibaren *χιλιάδες* («binler») gelir. Bu kelime **dişildir**, bu yüzden önündeki sayı da dişil olur: **τρεις**, **τέσσερις**, **δεκατρείς** χιλιάδες, **διακόσιες** χιλιάδες. *Δύο, πέντε, έξι*… değişmez. Ardından yüzlükler 4. dersteki gibi gelir: **δύο χιλιάδες τετρακόσια** ευρώ (2.400).
**Milyon** nötrdür: *ένα εκατομμύριο, δύο εκατομμύρια*.
Para: *το ευρώ* hiç değişmez (*χίλια ευρώ*). *Το δολάριο* ve *η λίρα* (Türk lirası ya da sterlin) çoğulda değişir: [[δύο δολάρια]], [[δύο λίρες]]. *Λίρα* dişil olduğu için *χίλιες λίρες* denir. Çoğul sonra gelecek; şimdilik tanıman yeter.
blocks.en:
**1,000** on its own is *χίλια*. From **2,000** you use *χιλιάδες* («thousands»). This word is **feminine**, so the number before it is feminine too: **τρεις**, **τέσσερις**, **δεκατρείς** χιλιάδες, **διακόσιες** χιλιάδες. *Δύο, πέντε, έξι*… never change. Then the hundreds come as in Lesson 4: **δύο χιλιάδες τετρακόσια** ευρώ (2,400).
A **million** is neuter: *ένα εκατομμύριο, δύο εκατομμύρια*.
Money: *το ευρώ* never changes (*χίλια ευρώ*). *Το δολάριο* and *η λίρα* (the Turkish lira, or the pound) change in the plural: [[δύο δολάρια]], [[δύο λίρες]]. *Λίρα* is feminine, so it is *χίλιες λίρες*. Plurals come later; for now just recognise them.

note.tr: Kalıp: sayı + χιλιάδες + yüzlük: 2.400 = δύο χιλιάδες τετρακόσια. 1.000 ise tek kelime: 1.200 = χίλια διακόσια.
note.en: The pattern: number + χιλιάδες + hundreds: 2,400 = δύο χιλιάδες τετρακόσια. 1,000 is one word: 1,200 = χίλια διακόσια.

items.el: Το κινητό κάνει χίλια διακόσια ευρώ.
Το παλιό αυτοκίνητο κάνει δύο χιλιάδες τετρακόσια ευρώ.
items.tr: Eski araba iki bin dört yüz euro.

items.el: Στη Σμύρνη το κινητό κάνει πενήντα χιλιάδες λίρες.
items.en: In Izmir the phone costs fifty thousand lira.

note.en: *Λίρες* is the plural: just recognise it.

blocks.tr: Bu dersin kelimeleri. Bölümü bitirince oturumlarına gelecekler.
blocks.en: The words of this lesson. They come into your sessions once you finish the chapter.

blocks.tr: **Sıfat artık değişiyor.** Türkçede *küçük çanta* ile *küçük ev* aynıdır. Yunancada *μικρή τσάντα* ama *μικρό σπίτι*. Önce ismin cinsiyetine bak (artikel söyler: *η*, *το*), sonra sıfatı ona uydur.
blocks.en: **The adjective now changes**, like French *petite / petit*: *μικρή τσάντα* but *μικρό σπίτι*. Check the noun's gender first (the article tells you), then match the adjective.

blocks.tr: **Cinsiyet uyumsuzluğu.** *Η τσάντα είναι μικρό* yanlış; *η τσάντα* dişil, o yüzden *μικρή*. Eşyalarda cinsiyet doğaya göre değil kelimeye göredir.
blocks.en: **Mismatch.** *Η τσάντα είναι μικρό* is wrong: *η τσάντα* is feminine, so *μικρή*. For things, the gender belongs to the word, not to the thing.

blocks.tr: Şimdi sen dene: sıfat uyumu, ikinci grup, ποιος, ήμουν / θα είμαι ve που.
blocks.en: Now you try: adjective agreement, group 2, ποιος, ήμουν / θα είμαι and που.
